chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

key_terms.الْحَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment or fixed penal right in this context
key_terms.يُورَثُ: is inherited or transferred to heirs

ai.seo_question: Does the right to demand a hadd punishment pass to heirs by inheritance in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the right connected to a hadd punishment is not transferred by inheritance. It indicates that this penal claim does not pass to heirs as inheritable property or personal estate.
